body:
# Client Sneak

![Logo](https://github.com/Vonr/clientsneak/raw/1.21/logo.png)

Fixes double crouching on servers ([MC-159163](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-159163)) by ignoring pose updates from the server for your own player.
